assumptions: The posted adjacent price is treated only as a competitive anchor and not as evidence of paid demand, transaction volume, or attractive margins.
Every job has valid customer authority and complete source inputs before transmission; the venture does not control or guarantee external approval.
Routine work can eventually be delegated to trained operators, but the target labor efficiency and founder time limit are not assumed to be proven.
The wholesaler route is optional and uncommitted; no favorable channel share, exclusivity, lead volume, or customer ownership is assumed.
The projected 300 active accounts, filing frequency, contribution range, retention, and founder wealth path remain illustrative planning assumptions.
evidence_needed_for_higher_score: An executed installer pilot followed by a paid minimum-volume wholesaler or unrelated-installer agreement, with at least a meaningful batch of real submissions measuring labor minutes, completion and return rates, turnaround, channel share, support and compliance cost, repeat purchase, cash collection, contribution per filing, and acquisition payback.

factors.name: Core insight
factors.rationale: This version correctly moves closer to the customer's job to be done: an authorized, current-form packet is prepared, transmitted, and evidenced by a receipt rather than merely checked. The adjacent commercial offer supports the logic of outsourced filing, but also shows that the insight is already understood and may be a service category rather than a distinctive control point.

factors.name: Customer pain and willingness to pay
factors.rationale: Document returns, mandatory attachments, changing templates, and administrative backlogs provide a credible reason to outsource preparation and transmission. A posted 145.53 PLN net adjacent offer supplies a useful price anchor, but its unavailable page and zero displayed reviews do not establish transactions, repeat demand, payer incidence, or willingness to buy this specific service.

factors.name: Business model and economics
factors.rationale: Charging at transmission, using prepaid blocks, and standardizing exception handling can support prompt cash conversion and repeat per-job revenue. At 149 PLN net, however, trained human handling, returned-filing work, secure storage, compliance, support, and a wholesaler revenue share leave limited room; the targeted 35-55% contribution, CAC payback, account volume, retention, and owner earnings are all unvalidated.

factors.name: Market and beachhead
factors.rationale: Polish renewable installers with recurring OSD filings form a testable beachhead, and a wholesaler can aggregate many installer relationships. The evidence does not establish annual eligible filing volume, account density, or the share willing to outsource, and slowing microinstallation growth limits conclusions drawn from the large installed base.

factors.name: Competitive position and domination potential
factors.rationale: White-label embedding and reliable multi-DSO execution could win a useful niche, especially if a wholesaler prefers outsourcing. The agreement is speculative and nonexclusive; wholesalers can internalize the desk, existing filing services can match it, platforms can add managed administration, and external institutions retain acceptance control, so durable domination is not yet structurally supported.

factors.name: Expansion potential
factors.rationale: Once packet operations and authorization are reliable, the service can add subsidy, warranty, battery, heat-pump, multiple-DSO, monitoring, and potentially regional filing workflows. Expansion can raise revenue per job, although each institution and geography adds specialized rules, liability, and operator training.

factors.name: Defensibility and durability
factors.rationale: Current-form playbooks, integrations, turnaround history, and embedded channel workflows may accumulate modest process advantage and switching friction. No proprietary data moat is assumed, agreements are replaceable, public rules can be copied, and a channel partner or software incumbent can internalize the operation once demand is visible.

factors.name: Strength of advantage
factors.rationale: Done-for-you preparation and transmission with an auditable receipt is materially stronger than a standalone checklist and can save installer administrative time. The packet contains no evidence of superior accuracy, turnaround, coverage, integration, or economics versus the near-identical adjacent offer, and the service cannot promise institutional acceptance.

factors.name: Timing and momentum
factors.rationale: Successor subsidy programs and changing DSO requirements sustain paperwork complexity, while document AI can increasingly assist operators. The relevant schemes and forms change frequently, the earlier program is closed, and sector growth has slowed, so rule churn is both a demand catalyst and a costly operational burden.

factors.name: Distribution
factors.rationale: A consented family-installer pilot is a credible first route, a wholesaler master agreement could aggregate acquisition efficiently, and direct unrelated-installer sales remain a fallback. No channel or pilot commitment exists, wholesaler economics are unknown, and the fallback could require fragmented sales to many small accounts at a low ticket.

factors.name: Execution and risks
factors.rationale: The founder can design and measure the workflow within the available capital and use AI to assist document handling. Scaling demands trained operators, continuously current rules, job-specific authority, processor contracts, security, quality assurance, support, and careful liability boundaries; those requirements may conflict with the founder's five-hour daily limit until delegation is proven.

highest_value_structural_change: Secure a minimum-volume wholesaler master contract for one narrowly standardized filing type, integrate directly with order and installer data, and price an SLA or monthly capacity commitment high enough to fund compliance and operator quality rather than relying mainly on 149 PLN spot jobs.
main_structural_strength: Revenue is tied to a concrete deliverable the venture can control—authorized preparation, transmission, and a receipt—while approval risk is explicitly left with the institution and both channel and direct acquisition routes remain available.
primary_score_limiter: The low per-filing price must absorb human fulfillment, exceptions, compliance, support, and potentially channel share without any demonstrated volume commitment, retention, or operating data, while the service remains easy for a wholesaler or platform to internalize.
strongest_disconfirming_evidence: A Polish wholesaler already advertises substantially the same completed OSD-filing outcome at 145.53 PLN net, yet the page was unavailable and showed zero reviews. This simultaneously demonstrates direct substitutability and leaves actual category demand unverified.
